title: note.move.workbench payload (v1)
description: Payload of the note.move.workbench outbox event. Producer: app/agents/panel_agent/runtime.py (config-driven zone_move panel actions): note_uuid/note_path/action_id/params. Consumer: app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_note_move_workbench, which requires payload.note_path (logs and returns early otherwise) and reads params.destination_zone (default 'workbench') plus action_id/intent_id. Requires note_path so the consumer can locate the vault action Guard chain's mutation target.
